what_to_detect: An eternalize ability resolves and creates a 4/4 token copy of its card (token_created in the effect half).
near_miss: An eternalize ability's resolution that creates no token.
record_fields: resolution effect half token_created event (CopyPermanentEffect is a TokenEffectBase)

acting line: the Eternalize keyword line, script_api_type Keyword, so api CopyPermanent does not select it; keyword_display_name Eternalize does; without either, token_created matches every token in the corpus
